text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?!
With how you are now, there's no way you'd lose a duel here!

A few days had passed since we restarted under
a new regime with Air Groove as our temporary coach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, Miss Still has also
announced her entry into the Queen Elizabeth II Cup."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have no time to be taking it easy.
We must—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. Would you prefer I explain everything from A to Z in painstaking detail?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't joke around like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh...!
...To think I got outrun in a duel again...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I won't yield it so easily.
...By the way—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Like clockwork every single time,
you launch your spurt from the exact same spot, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Assuming the conditions are identical, the optimal solution for victory should be the same.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
So that's why.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Run with me once more, Alv.
Except this time—we run without a set distance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand.
If so, when should I begin my spurt—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You can decide.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forget the optimal solution for winning for a moment.
Naturally, it is necessary for the actual race, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First... focus solely on overtaking me,
even if only for a single second.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your final stretch burst is terrifyingly sharp, but—
—I'm not afraid at all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You will regret... those words.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?! Is that all you've got?!
Admire Groove's late surge...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that's the best you can do...
you won't be able to properly compete with Still in Love at all!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
!
Don't... underestimate me...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"How is it?
Did that clear your head a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The way you've figured out how to use the power
needed to winâit isn't wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: At the same time, however, your late-stretch burst was shackled because of that—for fear that it might cause your defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I took it off for you.
So you can unleash yourself, just as your own impulses dictate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if you unleash your power to your impulses,
the current you can run it all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to fight in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
If you're going to keep chasing the "pinnacle" and your "ideals"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Focus on making them all "bow before you."
Don't start by thinking about winning or losing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That last late burst wasn't bad.
Don't forget that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Were you the one who forged Alv's late-stretch burst?
choice_data_list: No, no, it was like this originally. Though I did train it.

text_block_list.text: That's all thanks to her running form, which seamlessly converts full-body power into forward momentum. The foundation was already there before we even signed our contract.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well done. The weapon to fight in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
It really is that. Let's hone it even further.
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Good... Now take that next step even faster!
choice_data_list: ...Incredible. You're like a completely different person compared to half a month ago.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Though her abilities haven't particularly increased.
I merely gave her a tip on how to draw out her own power, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I have to win"... An obsession like that won't allow you to draw out your full potential.
choice_data_list: The only thing left is how you approach running itself, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. But as for that, it depends entirely on what
Álfr thinks herself, however—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (—I grew strong all on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Even with no one ahead of me, I wasn't at a loss.
I already knew which direction to take and how to move forward.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (And then, I became unable to see which way to go or how to move forward on my own—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...For the first time in my life, I'm chasing after someone's back.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (And in her running, in her words, something—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Just what... am I seeing
beyond Air Groove-san?)
—And then, the day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's about time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of giving a lengthy speech at this stage.
Everything that needed to be said was conveyed over these past two weeks."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
âGo on.
Show them... the power residing in those legs of yours.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Giving in to impulse... unleashing it. With my late burst—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(――Make every last one of them bow down.
Have no fear...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: âI'm off.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ahahahaha Ha ha...!!
I thought I couldn't eat another bite, but—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I never imagined you'd become even more delicious...♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —That's all I can tell you right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will... defeat you...!
With everything I am right now...!!"
The battle for her comeback begins—!
